matrix_convention: Column vectors: coordinates_imu = rotation_camera_to_imu * coordinates_camera; matrix columns are camera axes expressed in the IMU frame.
assumptions: The 3x3x1 mm Part 56 geometry is the ICM-20948 sensor package.
The camera uses +X right, +Y boresight, +Z up, as in look_vectors.py.
IMU +Z points in the same direction as camera +Y; parallel alone would not determine this sign.
The Adafruit board-axis marking is +X toward the left and +Y toward the top when viewed from the component side.
limitations: The STEP export labels the candidate as Part 56, not by the Adafruit product name.
The sensor/package axes and physical board mounting must be checked against the installed unit.
This mechanical estimate does not calibrate IMU attitude or magnetic heading.
This estimate is not applied in processing and must not be used for science.
